name: yf_earnings_dates
description:
Past and upcoming earnings announcement dates for one company from Yahoo Finance (yfinance earnings_dates).
Returns: {symbol, data_points, truncated, dates: [{Earnings Date, EPS Estimate, Reported EPS, Surprise(%)}]}, upcoming dates first; Reported EPS is empty for future dates.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T); limit (rows, 1-100; default 12, Yahoo sends at most about 25 by default).
Surprise detail for recent quarters: yf_earnings_history; the next event only: yf_calendar.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 8}
